package rulefixtures

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for transaction_error_translation_done_in_repository_and_handler: Both repository and handler layers translating the same transaction errors.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
var ErrNotFound = errors.New("not found")
var ErrConflict = errors.New("conflict")

type UserRepo struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func (r *UserRepo) Create(name string) error {
	err := r.db.Create(&struct{ Name string }{Name: name}).Error
	if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrDuplicatedKey) {
		return ErrConflict
	}
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("user repo create: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func CreateUserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	repo := &UserRepo{}
	err := repo.Create("test")
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrDuplicatedKey) {
			http.Error(w, "conflict", http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		if errors.Is(err, ErrConflict) {
			http.Error(w, "conflict", http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
}
